name: Brainwriting 6-3-5
deliverable: 108 structured ideas generated silently across six team members

steps.text: Seat six people, give each a sheet with three columns and five rows, and restate the question on the board.
For five minutes, each person writes three ideas, one per row, in the first column, in complete silence.
Pass every sheet one seat to the right, then each person reads it and adds three new ideas in the next column.
Repeat for five rounds so every sheet passes through every person and returns to its owner.
Collect the sheets, count the ideas, then cluster duplicates and themes before any discussion starts.

failure: Half-working looks like columns of restatements: people copy the idea above and change a word, so five rounds produce one idea written fifteen ways.
intervention: Before each pass, require that new ideas answer a different part of the question or change the mechanism, not just the wording.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A structured brainwriting format; no origin given in the source.
